production-provider-abuse-acceptance.note: The zero-write authenticated rivalry enumeration-denial probe avoided fabricating a third account or revoked device and returned the exact qualifying production permission denial with stable authentication and unchanged browser storage. It closed one fixed hardening capability and unlocked Stage 5A.

stage5a-candidate-emulator-proof.note: The exact GitHub Actions emulator job first exposed authority-read ordering and fixture-snapshot mismatches, then provider logs exposed expression-budget exhaustion on forged late-failing updates. Automated review subsequently found that entitled direct reads still lacked provider-verifiable current-device identity. The corrected client and candidate Rules now require an active device_id token claim, bind writes to it and prove missing, unknown, revoked and mismatched credentials fail closed.

stage5b-device-credential-foundation-pro.note: Contract, Chromium and Auth-plus-Firestore emulator proof forced the credential boundary from a user-wide mutable custom-claim concept to non-extractable P-256 proof of possession with per-sign-in device_id/device_key_sha256 claims. Codex review then caught that candidate Rules had not bound the key/version; direct Rules fixtures now close that gap. The owner's later permanent no-billing decision preserves Stage 5B as dormant research while selecting standard Google Auth plus exact-path Firestore Rules on Spark as the production critical path.

stage5c-standard-auth-session-adapter-pr.note: The zero-billing constraint forced an explicit honest boundary: ordinary Firebase uid proves the account, while a registered device ID is only account-owned mutation metadata and cannot prove physical-browser possession. Deterministic contracts plus real Auth-and-Firestore emulators preserve exact capability/no listing/exactly two accounts, deny missing or revoked device mutations, keep reads tied to uid plus entitlement and earn zero RJR until provider-live playable evidence exists.

stage5d-production-rules-provider-pendin.note: PR #176 proved exact Stage 5C-to-production-source blob lineage and merged with 14/14 exact-head plus 15/15 post-merge gates, but fixed RJR stays 87 because source/CI/merge add zero capability credit. Provider truth remains the older proven blob until authenticated Firebase publication is independently observed. Paid review quota exhaustion must never cause billing; the mandatory exact-head zero-billing fallback preserved review discipline.

stage5e-r3-owner-lifecycle-and-stale-poi.note: Owner evidence separated two truths: the provider-live Remote Joining lifecycle passed after manual rivalry alignment, while promised zero-manual-reattach QoL failed.
